description: LintRunner has run_cert_at_issuance() for audit mode, but DeviationRunner does not expose an equivalent. Callers using DeviationRunner in audit mode must manually extract notBefore and pass it to run_cert(). This is an API design gap: the two APIs are not symmetric, and the audit-mode pattern is undiscoverable. The DeviationRunner should add run_cert_at_issuance() mirroring LintRunner::run_cert_at_issuance(). Related to the ValidityMaxLint cap-time issue: audit mode is the correct mode for SC-081 compliance checking, and DeviationRunner needs to support it conveniently.
title: DeviationRunner missing run_cert_at_issuance audit-mode wrapper
